direction: Reset: simple buildable studio objects, no fantasy landscapes or people

concepts.title: 07-maqueta-sobre-portatil
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A single clean realistic Blender product render, landscape 3:2 composition. Start entirely fresh: this is a small physical desk object, NOT a fantasy landscape. On a seamless very dark charcoal studio background stands a closed unbranded graphite aluminum laptop. Sitting neatly ON its lid is a compact architectural scale model of Granada's Alhambra: recognizable square terracotta Torre de la Vela, two smaller rectangular crenellated towers and a short connecting fortified wall around a tiny courtyard with two simple cypress trees. Restrained accurate architectural proportions, understated fine stone texture, straight walls and real crenellations, not a generic medieval fairy-tale castle. The model is about 25cm wide, clearly a tabletop architectural model, modest amount of detail realistically achievable in Blender. The laptop is its understated pedestal and clearly identifiable by hinge, thin lid seam and a couple of side ports. A very small engraved 'UGR' on the laptop front edge is the only lettering. All geometry lies on the laptop lid, no landscape base, no floating structures. Camera three-quarter product view at 25 degrees above the table, entire object visible with generous empty margin, grounded soft contact shadow on a matte dark studio floor. Warm soft key light reveals terracotta stone, cool subtle rim light on graphite metal. High quality restrained physically based rendering, simple buildable geometry and beautiful materials, premium industrial design presentation. No people, no hands, no clouds, no mountains, no magical effects, no glowing circuits, no scenery, no other props, no Apple logo, no watermarks, no UI overlay. ONE product composition, not a collage.

concepts.title: 08-alhambra-en-la-pantalla
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One clean realistic Blender product visualization of an achievable small sculptural object linking Granada's Alhambra, computer engineering and UGR. Landscape 3:2, seamless charcoal black studio background and matte dark tabletop. An unbranded graphite laptop open at about 105 degrees, keyboard and trackpad clearly visible, screen almost black. At the screen's lower edge is a tiny architectural relief model of the Alhambra: one recognizable square terracotta Torre de la Vela and a short fortified wall with a smaller tower. The relief projects JUST A LITTLE physically out of the screen frame onto the hinge area, like a carefully fabricated architectural pop-up; most of the screen stays empty dark glass. Modest realistic architecture, straight crenellated walls and restrained details, no fairy-tale castle. The tiny off-white text 'UGR' appears alone in the upper-left corner of the otherwise blank screen. Keep this extremely simple: laptop + compact architectural relief only. Entire laptop visible, slightly off-center with generous empty space, three-quarter camera view that clearly shows the relief's shallow depth. Soft warm studio illumination on terracotta masonry, subtle cool rim on aluminum, convincing realistic materials and contact shadows, physically plausible construction except for the deliberate pop-up metaphor. Can be built in Blender with a laptop mesh and a modest architectural model. No people, no hands, no clouds, no floating islands, no mountains, no scenery, no holograms, no portals, no beams, no sparks, no code text, no complex UI, no brands, no watermark. SINGLE product render, not a collage.

concepts.title: 09-alhambra-placa-electronica
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A restrained realistic Blender studio product render of ONE compact desk sculpture combining the Alhambra of Granada with computer engineering and UGR. Landscape 3:2 on seamless almost-black charcoal background. A small rectangular dark graphite printed circuit board, about 24 by 18 cm, rests slightly raised on four short metal standoffs over a matte studio surface. The board has only a few elegant copper traces, two tiny chips and a sparse set of connection pads, not a busy motherboard. In its center stands a compact terracotta architectural model of the Alhambra: recognizable square Torre de la Vela, two smaller rectangular crenellated towers, connecting walls and one tiny courtyard. Simple architectural model quality with correct grounded proportions and subtle stone texture, not a generic fantasy castle. Copper traces approach the base of the model; they are real unlit copper, not neon. A tiny etched 'UGR' marking sits at the board's front corner. The board and architecture form one tidy physical object with no surrounding landscape. Beautiful balance of warm terracotta, dark matte PCB and understated copper. Oblique three-quarter camera view showing all of the sculpture with ample empty margin. Soft controlled studio light, warm key and restrained cool rim, realistic contact shadows and material response. Buildable in Blender with a small set of meshes; sophisticated simplicity rather than intricate complexity. No people, no hands, no clouds, no mountains, no vegetation landscape, no floating objects, no magic, no glowing circuitry, no LEDs, no other text, no watermark, no logos other than the small UGR inscription. One image, not a collage.
